subject: ShellPkg/UefiShellDriver1: Fix memory leaks
reasons: Adds ShellCommandLineFreeVarList(Package) before exiting a block in 3 files (Disconnect.c, OpenInfo.c, Reconnect.c)
Memory leak fixes require identifying specific code paths where the resource is not freed; each instance must be reasoned about individually
While the added call is the same, the surrounding context differs and there is no generic structural pattern that could be mechanically applied codebase-wide without false positives
